summary: Overall 2-page sheet geometry matches 1606 Jan 2018 ENCS; targeted fixes needed for Buyer/Seller Name & Address padding/overflow, Item 13 tax rate tenths alignment, Page 2 Taxpayer/Buyer Name comb alignment, Schedule 1 classification/alignment/padding, and screen Schedule 1 labels.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 7A and 8A (Buyer's/Seller's Name and Registered Address)
defects.what: Addresses collide with the left vertical border and long names sit flush against borders without overflow clipping.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Item 13 (Applicable Tax Rate)
defects.what: Decimal digit '0' sits flush against the right edge of the decimal separator bar instead of centered in the tenths box.

defects.where: Page 2, header Taxpayer's/Buyer's Name comb box
defects.what: Name prints as plain proportional text crossing the vertical comb ticks instead of one character per comb slot.
Classification column prints blank even when a classification (e.g. Agricultural/Commercial) is selected.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 table cells (TD No., Location, Area, FMV columns, TOTAL)
defects.what: FMV and TOTAL currency amounts are left-aligned flush against left borders instead of right-aligned with padding; text cells lack inner padding.

defects.where: Part IV, Schedule 1 (TCT, Area, FMV land, FMV improvements labels)
defects.what: Abbreviated labels ('TCT', 'Area', 'FMV land', 'FMV improvements') diverge from official captions and are inconsistent with Column 2 labels ('FMV of Land per BIR (zonal value)').

defects.where: Part I Item 8A (Seller's Name, Seller's Registered Address) and Schedule 1 Location
defects.what: Single-line text inputs clip long names and addresses horizontally inside ~240px inputs.

shared_changes_wanted: nsh/screens/form/: widen long single-line text inputs (names, addresses, locations) to use available card width instead of clipping at ~240px.
